parse_obj_file: create a python module that uses tinyobjloader ObjReader to parse a Wavefront OBJ file and check for errors
get_attrib_vertices: build a python script that extracts vertices, normals, and texcoords from a parsed OBJ file using GetAttrib
get_materials: create a python module that retrieves material definitions including diffuse color and texture names from an OBJ file
get_shapes_mesh: build a python script that extracts shape mesh indices with vertex, normal, and texcoord index data from an OBJ file
export_numpy_data: create a python module that exports OBJ vertex and mesh index data as numpy arrays using numpy_vertices and numpy_indices
